name: Louzolo
source: Louzolo is the steward that oversees the African Continent. Her family has always been seen as unusual, by vampire standards, as they were warm and caring. Her name means love and she was the personification of it. However, a few centuries ago, something changed this. She is very close with all of her children, including [url=/c129645]Zyair[/url], and treats [url=/c129648]Tasha[/url] as one of her own.
